senses.en: (BrE also generalisation) a statement about all the members of a group that may be true in some or many situations but is not true in every case
examples: You can't make [[generalizations]] about what men and women are like.

senses.zh: （许多人相信的）错误观念，荒诞说法
senses.en: an idea or story that many people believe, but which is not true
examples: Contrary to the popular [[myth]], women are not worse drivers than men.

senses.en: (fml.) a husband or wife
examples: Please notice that [[spouses]] are welcome to the company picnic.

senses.en: (fml.) (only before noun) connected with a husband or wife; of or from a husband or wife
examples: Here are the 10 things you should never say in a [[spousal]] argument.

senses.en: feeling annoyed and impatient because you cannot do or achieve what you want
examples: Stacy got so [[frustrated]] that she stood up and walked out of the room.

senses.en: the state of being logical and true
examples: We had serious doubts about the [[validity]] of their argument.

senses.en: (~ from) develop as a result of sth. else
examples: He told the magazine in an exclusive interview that all his misfortune [[stemmed]] from a lack of tolerance toward others.
He told the magazine in an exclusive interview that all his misfortune [[stemmed]] from a lack of tolerance toward others.

senses.zh: （为找到食物、补给等）四处搜寻
senses.en: go around searching for food or other supplies
examples: When it's cold and snowy outside, birds may [[forage]] for food in your backyard.

senses.en: (pl. millennia /mɪˈleniə/) a period of 1,000 years
examples: The year 2000 was celebrated as the beginning of the third [[millennium]].

senses.en: based on instinct, not thought or training
examples: Animals provide the best examples of [[instinctive]] behavior.

senses.en: (fml.) a particular way or style of behaving, living, or doing sth.
examples: Many children recognize that cycling and walking are environmentally-friendly [[modes]] of transportation.

senses.en: the process of giving or getting the right type of food for good health and growth
examples: It is widely known that [[nutrition]] and exercise are essential to fitness and health.

senses.en: (of food) containing many of the substances which help the body to grow
examples: The cookbook contains many simple yet highly [[nutritious]] meals.

senses.zh: 适宜食用的；（无毒而）可以吃的
senses.en: fit or suitable to be eaten; not poisonous
examples: There are many [[edible]] fruits growing wild in the coastal forest.

senses.en: get rid of sth.
examples: Would you help me remove the seeds from the melon and [[discard]] them?

senses.en: heavily loaded with sth.
examples: He was surprised to find that the tables were [[laden]] with food.

senses.en: the traditional beliefs, values, customs, etc. of a family, country, or society
examples: These works of art are of great importance to Russia's national [[heritage]].

senses.zh: 史前的；有历史记载以前的
senses.en: relating to the time in history before anything was written down
examples: We do not have to go back to [[prehistoric]] times to witness the change in our diet.

senses.en: sth. that you buy or obtain, often to add to things that you already have
examples: The Art Society is holding an exhibition of recent [[acquisitions]].
We need to recognize that second language [[acquisition]] is a gradual developmental process.

senses.en: the process by which you gain knowledge or learn a skill
examples: The Art Society is holding an exhibition of recent [[acquisitions]].
We need to recognize that second language [[acquisition]] is a gradual developmental process.

senses.zh: （空气或气候）温暖潮湿的，湿热的
senses.en: (of the air or climate) warm and damp
examples: It was a hot, [[humid]] day, and the only sound was the buzzing of insects.

senses.en: (fml.) a particular quality in sb.'s character
examples: It's a human [[trait]] to joke about subjects that make us uncomfortable.

senses.en: an inclination toward a particular characteristic or type of behavior
examples: For students, there is a [[tendency]] to socialize in the evenings.

senses.en: a person who studies anthropology
examples: [[Anthropologists]] study the origin, development, and functioning of human societies and cultures.

senses.zh: 相似性；类似性；相似处；相似点
senses.en: the state of being almost the same, or a particular way in which sth. is almost the same
examples: The police are checking for [[similarities]] with other recent attacks in the area.

senses.en: a member of your family who lived a long time ago
examples: Although I'm British myself, my [[ancestors]] were actually French.

senses.en: of, relating to, or inherited from an ancestor
examples: The house is the [[ancestral]] home of Baron Stourton, but after the family moved out in the 1960s it fell into disrepair.

senses.zh: 有做某事的意向；倾向于做某事
senses.en: (be ~ to do sth.; be ~ to sth.) be likely to do sth. or behave in a particular way
examples: They'll be more [[inclined]] to listen carefully if you don't shout.

senses.en: (only before noun) long or longer than usual or expected
examples: If you are going abroad for an [[extended]] period of time, you should consider renting your house out.

senses.zh: 以实验（经验）为依据的；经验主义的
senses.en: (only before noun) based on experiments or experience rather than ideas or theories
examples: There is strong [[empirical]] evidence to suggest that these concerns are not trivial.

senses.en: a good reason why sth. exists or is done
examples: I can see no possible [[justification]] for your being late.

senses.zh: 经遗传获得（品质、身体特征等）
senses.en: have qualities, physical features, etc. that are similar to those of your parents, grandparents, etc.
examples: Mr. Grass [[inherited]] his work ethic from his father.
He [[inherited]] a large sum of money from his grandmother about 10 years ago.

senses.en: receive money, property, etc. from sb. when they die
examples: Mr. Grass [[inherited]] his work ethic from his father.
He [[inherited]] a large sum of money from his grandmother about 10 years ago.

senses.zh: 明智的；合理的；实际的；有判断力的
senses.en: reasonable, practical, and showing good judgment
examples: People are far more [[sensible]] about what and how much they drink these days.

senses.en: have an effect on or concern a particular person, group, or situation
examples: The offer only [[applies to]] flights from London and Manchester.

senses.en: whatever is needed to achieve sth.
examples: I have to avoid being late for work again [[at all costs]], or I'll lose my job.

senses.en: (BrE, spoken) immediately or without delay
examples: I wrote him a letter and posted it [[straight away]].

senses.zh: 谈及；就···而言；在···方面；从···方面来说
senses.en: (also in … terms) used to show what aspects of a subject you are talking about or how you are thinking about it
examples: It's a mistake to think of Florida only in terms of its tourist attractions.

senses.en: (also in respect of) (fml.) concerning or in relation to sth.
examples: The two groups were similar with respect to income and status.

senses.en: similar to, or at the same level as sth.
examples: The new policy is [[in line with]] the plans that were discussed last year.

senses.en: (before common era)

senses.zh: 中东（一般泛指欧、亚、非三洲连接的地区）
